title: Fourth-third norm of a zero-one function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the Boolean cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. Suppose $f$ takes only the values $0$ and $1$, and its uniform mean is $\\alpha$. Then the square of its uniform $L^{4/3}$ norm is $\\alpha^{3/2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube of dimension $n$
